kaikki_vikisozluk.e: الْبَحْر الْأَبْيَض الْمُتَوَسِّط • (al-baḥr al-ʔabyaḍ al-mutawassiṭ) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: By surface analysis, بَحْر (baḥr, “sea”) + أَبْيَض (ʔabyaḍ, “white”) + مُتَوَسِّط (mutawassiṭ, “middle”), literally “the middle white sea”. Calque of Ottoman Turkish آق دكز (literally “white sea”).
